## Your Satisfaction Guaranteed.

Our customer’s satisfaction is everything to us. When you work with Apex, we guarantee that you will love our work. We prioritize warranty work over new projects and will show up within **48 hours** to address any problems.

Our concrete coating work comes with a **30-Year Warranty** and our pools come with a **7-Year Warranty**.
